correctness.rationale: All geometric boundary fibers are accounted for: one affine point and one additional smooth ramified point over u=0, plus the unique totally ramified point above infinity. For Fp every affine fiber but u=-1 is singleton and the exception reduces to parity and p|(2n+1). For Fp² the map v↦uv^p+v is bijective off the norm-one torus and has image u b^p=b of size p on it; the exponent reduction u^a_i=w^i completes an exhaustive count. Nine explicit exact field enumerations replayed and agree; the general conclusion is proved symbolically.

Their exact congruence-dependent jumps distinguish Frobenius traces invisible to high-extension maximality and provide concrete input to further full-zeta and isogeny investigations. This is a coherent two-coefficient result, not an arbitrary finite slice.
